assignments.role: Backend Dynamic Video Pipeline, Vision Models & Atomic Job Result Exposure
assignments.scope: 1) Gemini Vision Model Updates: In vision_analyzer.py, replace retired models returning 404 (gemini-1.5-flash, gemini-2.0-flash, gemini-2.5-pro) with active models (gemini-3.8-flash, gemini-2.5-flash, gemini-3.1-pro-preview), increase read timeout if needed, and ensure uploaded video keyframes are successfully analyzed by Gemini Vision without premature fallback. 2) Atomic Job Result Exposure & Video Dynamic URL: In web/server.py and web/pipeline_bridge.py, ensure /api/status/{job_id} reports 'completed' only AFTER the final cut and video annotations are 100% finished and flushed to disk. Return the dynamic output video URL for the specific job (e.g. data['video_url'] / data['output_video_url']) and atomically update /outputs/final_cut.mp4. Support serving the specific job cut. 3) Author tests in tests/test_dynamic_video_pipeline.py. 4) Zero U+0669. Update web/README.md. Commit as MohammedBoure. Signal idle via notify_coordinator_worker_idle.

Update web/static/README.md. Commit as MohammedBoure. Signal idle via notify_coordinator_worker_idle.

assignments.scope: Author integration and E2E verification tests in tests/test_dynamic_video_delivery.py: 1) Verify vision model hierarchy and retry resiliency. 2) Verify status polling states (extracting -> analyzing -> synthesizing -> rendering -> annotating -> completed) and verify output video URL returned is dynamic and specific to the job. 3) Verify that /api/status/{job_id} does not return completed until output file exists and is readable. 4) Verify frontend DOM contracts for dynamic video playback and cache-busting. 5) Run test suites, verify zero U+0669 across repository, merge backend and frontend branches into develop, commit as MohammedBoure, update agent_assignments.json to COMPLETED, and signal idle via notify_coordinator_worker_idle.
